notes.title: 🎮 Claw & Load Demo – New Update Is Ready!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Miners and Meowling Commanders![/b]

The [b]Claw & Load[/b] demo is getting an update! We've fixed bugs, added fresh content, and made improvements across the board — from smoother controls and better maps to a new boss, UI tweaks, and even a long-awaited tutorial and challenge mode.

[h3]✅ What's New in This Update[/h3][olist]  [*]    [b]Character Control Improvements[/b]    [list]      [*]Increased base movement speed and acceleration[/*]      [*]Added new movement-speed-related upgrade options[/*]      [*]Buffed existing movement-related upgrades[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Magnet Item Rework[/b]    [list]      [*]Removed the need for external upgrades to collect minerals[/*]      [*]Now collects both minerals and XP by default[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Machine Gun Upgrade Path[/b]    [list]      [*]Added global damage boost against enemies for all weapons[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Cat Archer Buffs[/b]    [list]      [*]Increased damage on E and Q skills[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Map & Resource Adjustments[/b]    [list]      [*]Tweaked the number and placement of explosive blocks in early and snowy areas[/*]      [*]Improved terrain between snowy area and treehole maze[/*]      [*]Increased spawn points and frequency of blue mineral vendors and iron balls[/*]      [*]Increased mineral drop rate in the cellar area[/*]      [*]Adjusted meowshroom spawn zones and quantity[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Game Pace Tweaks[/b]    [list]      [*]Delayed the "Dark Night" event in the snowy area from 25 to 30 minutes[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]New Gameplay Content[/b]    [list]      [*]Added post-clear [b]Challenge Mode[/b][/*]      [*]Introduced a new boss in the [b]Demonic Portal Zone[/b][/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Poison Pool Changes[/b]    [list]      [*]Changed to low HP drain + heavy Adjustments[/b]    [list]      [*]Added multiple new orange relic effects[/*]      [*]Fixed bug where single-limit relics could appear multiple times[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Visual Effects[/b] [b]The updated demo will be live very soon — we’d love for you to give it a try![/b]
Feel free to share your thoughts or report bugs in our Discord server.  We’re actively improving the game and working toward a stronger, fuller release!

notes.title: Try the Demo Now!
notes.content:
[b]🚀 Our Demo is Now Live on Steam! 🚀[/b]

Hi everyone!
We’re thrilled to announce that the demo for our game is officially available!
You can now experience the exciting combination of mining, shooting, and surviving — alongside our mischievous cat companion! 🐾

👉 [url=store.steampowered.com/app/3687820/_Demo/]Play the Demo Here![/url]

[h3]What’s New Compared to the Playtest:[/h3]

[h3]Level Design[/h3]
[list]
[*] Early-game pacing has been significantly adjusted.
[*] The first half of Canyon of the Dead has been completely reworked, with clearer stage transitions focused on the mining phase.
[*] A new snowy biome and block type have been added.
[*] A mysterious cellar region is now explorable.
[*] One new level variant has also been introduced.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new block types: rolling blocks and barrel blocks.
[*] More Cat Spirit weapons, special affixes, and achievements.
[*] Introduced a new difficulty system and unlockable features.
[*] Improved upgrade paths for various mining guns.
[*] Optimized how super weapons are obtained.
[*] Refined enemy formations, especially those that surround the player.
[/list]
[h3]UI Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] New selection interfaces for character, weapon, map, and difficulty.
[*] Various game and alert UI elements have been optimized.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] A large number of bugs have been fixed to improve overall stability and gameplay.
[/list]

[b]A Big Thank You![/b]
We want to give a huge shoutout to everyone who participated in our previous Playtest.
Your feedback has been incredibly valuable in helping us polish the game.
Special thanks to: [b]AraAra, RAW with Kohut, 旭, 云灬容[/b] — your suggestions truly made a difference!

We also warmly welcome everyone to continue sharing your feedback and suggestions in our Discord. We’re excited to hear your thoughts and keep making the game better together!

Thank you all for your support, and we can't wait to hear what you think! ❤️
